INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE                                  
 
ORACLE                                                                
Sanika Chandode, B. Tech Computers (2020-24) 
 
Oracle visited our campus in August 2023 to hire final year students. 
Criteria: 
1. CPI: 7 and above 
2. Class X: 70% and above 
3. Class XII: 70% and above 
4. Branches: CS, IT, Electrical, EXTC, Electronics. 
Rounds: 
1. Online Coding Round 
2. Technical Round – 1 (offline) 
3. Technical Round – 2 + HR round (offline) 
 
Round 1: Online Coding round (100 mins) 
It was an online test on Hackerrank Platform. It consisted of 4 sections 
Section 1: code for LIS (Longest Increasing Subsequence) 
Section 2: 10 MCQ questions on Aptitude 
Section 3: 10 MCQ questions on English Vocabulary and Grammar 
Section 4: one API question 
40 students for shortlisted for role 1(FCD), and 15 for role 2(OFSS) for 
interviews. 
 
Round 2: Technical Round – 1 (approx. 45-50 mins)  
First PPT was scheduled on 14th August and after that Offline interviews were 
scheduled.  
1. Tell me about yourself.

2. Asked me about my recent project, as it was in flutter and firebase, asked 
me questions about it and, also asked how I implemented some features. 
3. 2 sum problem: 
Gave 3 approaches:  
1) 2 for unsorted array: using brute force and using map 
2)1 for sorted array: using 2 pointers 
4. Asked some questions about map 
5. Asked to swap numbers: I did it using 3 variables then told me to use 
only 2 variables 
6. Gave 2 SQL queries which can be solved using joins and order-by clause. 
7. Asked about set data structure in C++ and its properties 
8. Asked me to implement class set having insert function: it should not 
contain duplicates 
I gave 3 approaches and both interviewers were quite satisfied. 
 
In this way, the interview almost came to an end. At last, they asked if I 
had some questions 
 
Round 3: Technical Round – 2 + HR (approx. 50-55 mins) 
1. Introduce yourself. 
2. Asked me to implement one flutter page and asked me questions over it. 
And, also compared java application development and flutter 
development 
3. Then he asked if I am familiar with compiler design, this is the subject 
which we had in 5th sem. I said I barely remember anything. Still, he 
started asking questions about it. I told him that I am not able to recall it 
and indirectly or directly told him to not ask questions about it. 
4. Then he asked me to solve expression and code it. Like what will be the 
value of a+ b+ c or a+ b*c or a+ (b + c * d) + f 
I took 2 to 3 cases and gave solution using 2 stacks. 
5. Asked me normalization and different types of normalization and asked 
to explain with tables 
6. Asked about prime and non-prime attributes. 
7. Difference between unique, primary and candidate key and, also super 
key 
8. We had detailed discussion on linked lists and array

Then I asked some questions about the tech stack. 
9. Then some basic HR questions, like about family and then one 
mandatory question: 
Where do you see yourself in 5 years? 
 
The Final results were announced at about 5:40 pm, 19 people were 
selected and I was fortunate to be one of them. 
 
Tips: 
Personal Note:  
Even If you don’t get selected for internship. Do not worry, just keep studying 
but this time study harder! Make sure you learn from your failures. At the end 
hardwork pays off.
